threat_categories.name: Wardrobing
threat_categories.description: High-value occasionwear or luxury apparel ordered for a single event and returned after use.

threat_categories.name: Bracketing Abuse
threat_categories.description: Ordering multiple sizes or colors of high-cost items simultaneously with the intention of returning variants.

threat_categories.name: Serial-Returner Fraud
threat_categories.description: Chronic return abuse and velocity exploitation (>65% return rate, prior payment chargebacks).

threat_categories.name: False Damage Claims & Arbitrage
threat_categories.description: Claiming sealed high-resale electronics arrived damaged or requesting instant cash conversion on COD returns.
